# cloudflare_workflow (Data Source)

Accepted Permissions

- `Workers Scripts Read`
- `Workers Scripts Write`
- `Workers Tail Read`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_workflow" "example_workflow" {
  account_id = "account_id"
  workflow_name = "x"
}
```
